claude_proposed_widenings.name: mixed_magic_item_mechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines always-on passive benefits with a separate reaction-based charge-spend ability, but MagicItemMechanics currently allows only one family at a time.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This beetle-shaped medallion provides three benefits while it is on your person.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_source_filter_against_spells
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Current roll-advantage shaping can narrow by save ability, but not by the source of the save such as spells.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells.
